method: Matched complete-sequence gradient training; fixed corpus, costs, policy/belief head weights
limitations: Two optimizer seeds; selected cavern fixtures, not world generalization
Fixed policy/belief heads can change outputs when their representation changes
Forecast-only objective; no policy or belief preservation loss
Only encoder depth differs between joint variants; predictor architecture fixed
Four dice streams per ranking fixture: diagnostic only
Training/validation corpus reused; fresh forecast and encounter evaluation seeds
Predictor-only baseline uses same sequential loss/batch budget as joint variants, not the historical sampler
corpus: curriculum-learning-v1 replay and validation; original withdrawal-cornered-v6 checkpoints

training.loss: observation MSE +10 HP-change MSE +2 admission MSE +4 normalized damage MSE
training.sampling: fixed episode batches; seed-shuffled batch order; inverse-action-frequency transition loss weights
training.checkpoint_selection: lowest unweighted validation loss, never forecast test or encounter outcomes
training.scope: predictor; additionally encoder and GRU in unfrozen/deeper; policy and belief head parameters fixed
